newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet premiums steady in subdued market.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet premiums steady in subdued market.

text.p: European jet fuel prices and premiums were steady on Monday in listless post-weekend activity, traders said.
Nov IPE futures were $1 firmer at $225.25 on heating oil's apparent recovery on NYMEX on Friday.
Jet fuel cargoes cif NWE were at Nov IPE +$30/31 for early November. In the Med early November was unchanged at fob Med high +$5/6 for EU-qualified material.
Barges for early November were Nov IPE +$33/33.50. Premiums were supported by supply factors stemming from reports that refiners are turning jet fuel into low sulphur diesel.
